recommended_next_source.why: It is the only source family with a credible combination of direct toilet evidence, clear licensing on selected resources, public machine-readable examples and a low/medium-effort path. The first batch must choose name-bearing current OGL resources; the audited Sheffield resource is a quality warning, not an ingestible win.
recommended_next_source.smallest_next_implementation_batch: Select two to five current coordinate-bearing council resources with explicit OGL, stable row identifiers and names; download content-addressed snapshots; normalize without production writes; measure exact overlap; stop if names/CRS/licence/status are insufficient.
